# telnyx_rcs_agent (Data Source)

An RCS agent, the branded sender of RCS business messages, registered under an RCS brand. The API cannot delete agents, so destroy only removes the agent from Terraform state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifies the RCS agent.

### Read-Only

- `basics_status` (String) The review status of the agent basics.
- `billing_category` (String) The billing category assigned to the agent.
- `brand_id` (String) The RCS brand the agent belongs to.
- `campaign_status` (String) The review status of the agent campaign.
- `capabilities` (Attributes) What the agent's registration path supports. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--capabilities))
- `carrier_approvals` (Attributes List) The agent's approval by each carrier. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--carrier_approvals))
- `configuration` (Attributes) The agent's registration details. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configuration))
- `display_name` (String) The name shown to recipients as the sender.
- `hosting_region` (String) The region where the agent is hosted.
- `profile_id` (String) A Messaging Profile owned by the authenticated organization. When omitted, the agent inherits the brand profile.
- `status` (String) The registration state of the agent.
- `test_devices` (Attributes List) The test devices invited to the agent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--test_devices))
- `testing_status` (String) The status of the agent's testing.
- `use_case` (String) The kind of messages the agent sends. One of `MULTI_USE`, `OTP`, `PROMOTIONAL`, `TRANSACTIONAL`.

<a id="nestedatt--configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configuration`

Read-Only:

- `basics` (String) Basic agent identity and contact information. At least one complete phone, website, or email contact is required. A JSON document; use `jsonencode()`.
- `campaign` (Attributes) The campaign details required to launch the agent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configuration--campaign))
- `testing` (Attributes) Testing evidence required to launch the agent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configuration--testing))

- `interactions` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configuration--campaign--interactions))
